Attached: 1 image

Agent Cost Analyzer 0.15.0 is out (it was gh-cp-chat-analyser).

It reads the logs Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and the pi coding agent already write on your machine and shows what each session cost, turn by turn: cache reads and writes, tool calls, failures.

Replay a session on another model to see what it would have cost there. The Savings report ranks the changes that would lower your spend.

Local and read-only: nothing leaves your machine.

https://github.com/raulkivi/agent-cost-analyzer
